patterns.note: Full-bleed, immersive video hero section with a central, high-contrast text overlay.
Asymmetrical text blocks combined with varied image grid layouts to create dynamic visual rhythm, particularly in the 'Everyone sees design differently' section.
Prominent, large sans-serif headings for section titles, often paired with a contrasting smaller, lighter text or a distinct serif font for descriptive copy.
High contrast between a dark, dramatic hero section and a clean, light off-white background for the main content areas.
A persistent, sticky top navigation bar and a small informational banner remain visible throughout the scroll, while content scrolls over a fixed or subtly parallaxing full-bleed video hero.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video is used as a dramatic hero background, with a semi-transparent overlay to ensure text readability. The video remains fixed or subtly parallaxes as the page content scrolls over it, transitioning from the dark hero background to a light content background.

A top navigation bar, featuring a personal signature logo, and a small informational banner are implemented as sticky elements, maintaining their position at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.

Section content is structured using a combination of large, impactful image cards and multi-column grids, with generous vertical spacing to create an airy feel and clear visual separation between content blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~3-4x body size) are paired with a more traditional serif for descriptive hero text and a clean sans-serif for body copy, creating a balanced yet impactful hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., on input fields, ~4-8px), otherwise sharp for most elements and images.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and within the hero, creating a sense of spaciousness and allowing content to breathe.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dramatic, full-bleed video hero with a minimalist, high-contrast text overlay immediately sets a sophisticated and personal tone. The integration of a handwritten signature in the sticky navigation further reinforces a unique, artistic brand identity, making the portfolio feel curated and personal rather than a generic template.
